status.detail: The settled narrow candidate retains twenty actual-script real-Git passes against eighteen baseline controls and two expected identity gaps. A separate root-only experiment retained independently verified evidence for eight baseline vectors, including two specific log.showRoot=false equal-patch gaps, and eight passing candidate vectors. Both workers drained naturally and released the sole lock. Source adjudication accepts a conditional root-omission P2 and rejects broader header/default-root claims. The exact combined literal candidate contains only the accepted identity edits and --root; it is LF-only and statically parsed, but remains untested. Validation preparation stopped before execution because identity and root suites alone predict 1,024 baseline and 1,048 candidate native dispatches, exceeding the unchanged per-worker limit of 800 before the eight upstream cases. No budget increase or coverage reduction occurred. Separate finite-suite preparation is assigned with all coverage, custody limits and capture namespaces preserved. Earlier failures and the prior raw-stream loss remain immutable. The seventh Lite review is not convergence; the root thread, exact combined validation, full-tree and literal-suggestion gates remain open.
